frozen_pass_rule: Before outcomes: freeze primary endpoint, independent unit, split, baselines, sample-size/power, SESOI, missingness, exclusions, code hash, and analysis
fail_or_inconclusive_rule: No confirmatory data collection until complete; any post-result change becomes exploratory/new study
notes: SESOI is endpoint-specific, justified and set before confirmatory outcomes; not retrofitted

frozen_pass_rule: Correct paired/cluster inference; 95% interval in predicted direction and beyond frozen SESOI; replicate for general claim
fail_or_inconclusive_rule: Interval spans null/useful region=inconclusive; comparator favored or upper bound nonpositive=contradicted under frozen test
notes: Rows nested in seed/task are not independent units

frozen_pass_rule: Development diagnostics show policies make materially different ranking/selection choices under constrained capacity; decisions are logged before outcome access
fail_or_inconclusive_rule: If strategies make identical choices or only one candidate is eligible, superiority question is not identified; redesign before confirmatory run
notes: Pressure diagnosis is a design-validity gate, not an outcome win

frozen_pass_rule: Selection/ranking benchmark, memory challenge, capability validation protocol, and ARC coverage audit are built, tested, and frozen; baseline and v1.0 reference on same locked splits; ARC fit vs task accuracy separated
fail_or_inconclusive_rule: If benchmark leaks, pressure absent, denominators ambiguous, or budget not consistent, Bronze not achieved
notes: Engineering readiness only; no theory claims

frozen_pass_rule: RQ1 and RQ2 each pass primary comparison and independent replication; RQ4 capability score validates against independent behavioral criterion
fail_or_inconclusive_rule: Any primary failure remains failure; missing external criterion means CGM validation not passed
notes: RQ5 separately evaluated; Silver does not certify intelligence growth

frozen_pass_rule: On frozen ARC evaluation, valid invariants and skills form, skill transfer is measurable, a validated capability group forms, and held-out exact task benefit vs no-learning clears frozen gate
fail_or_inconclusive_rule: Any stage unavailable or no held-out task benefit means partial activation, not Gold
notes: Must preserve public training/evaluation access boundaries and correct Kaggle competition rules

frozen_pass_rule: Core claims replicate across independent generator/domain; ARC external result and public Kaggle entry/score are documented; all claims within validated scope
fail_or_inconclusive_rule: No replication or no valid Kaggle submission means Platinum not met
notes: Prize placement is judged externally and cannot be guaranteed by this research gate

frozen_pass_rule: On identical locked tasks, report exact-demo-fit coverage for v1.0 and v1.1 under explicit budgets; quantify paired improvement and report test-task accuracy separately
fail_or_inconclusive_rule: Demo-fit gain without held-out accuracy is representation progress only; no claim of ARC solving
notes: Do not revise v1.0 result; include candidate-budget conformance

frozen_pass_rule: Equal data/storage/query/compute budget; distinguish exact replay, seen components/new combinations, and new contexts; log leakage audit
fail_or_inconclusive_rule: If exact solutions leak or budgets differ, abstraction-vs-memory comparison invalid
notes: Include memory-only and hybrid results, not just ASFT-favoring cases

frozen_pass_rule: Primary score predicts independent future behavioral test beyond prior performance/exposure under frozen out-of-sample criterion; replicate
fail_or_inconclusive_rule: Metric correlates only with its own components or not with independent behavior = no construct validation
notes: Separate score movement, task accuracy, breadth, persistence, and capability count

frozen_pass_rule: IG adds prediction of preregistered external future-learning/adaptation target beyond baseline and experience, replicated
fail_or_inconclusive_rule: No independent target or no incremental value = retain as internal index, do not call intelligence growth
